hidden_sugars.name: Maltodextrin
hidden_sugars.risk: Extremely high glycemic index (higher than table sugar); causes rapid glucose and insulin spikes while often disguised as a complex carb.

hidden_sugars.name: Invert Sugar
hidden_sugars.risk: Equimolar mixture of glucose and fructose; common in biscuits and confectionery to retain moisture.

hidden_sugars.name: Invert Sugar Syrup
hidden_sugars.risk: Concentrated liquid sugar used for texture and sweetening.

hidden_sugars.name: Liquid Glucose
hidden_sugars.risk: Refined corn or wheat starch syrup causing rapid blood sugar elevation.

hidden_sugars.name: High Fructose Corn Syrup
hidden_sugars.risk: High-fructose industrial syrup associated with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) and insulin resistance.

hidden_sugars.name: HFCS-55
hidden_sugars.risk: Common beverage grade corn syrup with 55% free fructose.

hidden_sugars.name: HFCS-42
hidden_sugars.risk: Common bakery grade corn syrup with 42% free fructose.

hidden_sugars.name: Sucrose
hidden_sugars.risk: Standard refined table sugar composed of 50% glucose and 50% fructose.

hidden_sugars.name: Dextrose
hidden_sugars.risk: Pure D-glucose that enters the bloodstream directly with zero digestion required.

hidden_sugars.name: Dextrose Monohydrate
hidden_sugars.risk: Crystallized glucose widely used in processed snack seasonings and drink powders.

hidden_sugars.name: Fructose
hidden_sugars.risk: Free fructose metabolized exclusively by the liver; excessive intake promotes hepatic de novo lipogenesis (fatty liver).

hidden_sugars.name: Maltose
hidden_sugars.risk: Malt sugar with high glycemic response.

hidden_sugars.name: Barley Malt Extract
hidden_sugars.risk: Commonly used in 'health' malt food drinks; high in maltose and added sugars.

hidden_sugars.name: Malt Extract
hidden_sugars.risk: Cereal-derived sweetener with significant glycemic load.

hidden_sugars.name: Corn Syrup
hidden_sugars.risk: Concentrated glucose solution extracted from maize.

hidden_sugars.name: Corn Syrup Solids
hidden_sugars.risk: Dehydrated corn syrup used in coffee creamers, protein powders, and dressings.

hidden_sugars.name: Rice Syrup
hidden_sugars.risk: Often marketed as a 'natural' alternative, but composed almost entirely of high-GI maltotriose and maltose.

hidden_sugars.name: Brown Rice Syrup
hidden_sugars.risk: Misleadingly viewed as healthy; produces intense post-prandial glycemic spikes.

hidden_sugars.name: Date Syrup
hidden_sugars.risk: Concentrated fructose and glucose from dates; counts as added sugar in processed foods.

hidden_sugars.name: Date Powder
hidden_sugars.risk: Used in 'no added sugar' baby foods and snacks to deliver high sugar concentration legally.

hidden_sugars.name: Apple Juice Concentrate
hidden_sugars.risk: Stripped of fiber and polyphenols, functioning chemically as concentrated liquid fructose/glucose.

hidden_sugars.name: Grape Juice Concentrate
hidden_sugars.risk: Common clean-label sweetener hiding substantial added sugar volume.

hidden_sugars.name: Agave Nectar
hidden_sugars.risk: Heavily processed syrup containing 70-90% free fructose, worse for liver metabolic health than table sugar.

hidden_sugars.name: Golden Syrup
hidden_sugars.risk: Thick amber sugar syrup produced during sugar cane refining.

hidden_sugars.name: Molasses
hidden_sugars.risk: Viscous byproduct of sugar refining.

hidden_sugars.name: Treacle
hidden_sugars.risk: Concentrated sugar syrup.

hidden_sugars.name: Cane Sugar
hidden_sugars.risk: Unrefined or semi-refined sucrose.

hidden_sugars.name: Organic Cane Sugar
hidden_sugars.risk: Identical metabolic impact to conventional white table sugar.

hidden_sugars.name: Turbinado Sugar
hidden_sugars.risk: Coarse cane sugar retaining trace molasses; minimal nutritional difference from refined sucrose.

hidden_sugars.name: Demerara Sugar
hidden_sugars.risk: Large grain brown sugar; same metabolic load as white sugar.

hidden_sugars.name: Muscovado Sugar
hidden_sugars.risk: Contains minerals but still 90%+ sucrose.

hidden_sugars.name: Panela
hidden_sugars.risk: Solid unrefined cane sugar blocks.

hidden_sugars.name: Jaggery
hidden_sugars.risk: Gud/Gur contains trace iron and minerals, but has a very high glycemic index (~84); diabetics must strictly monitor intake.

hidden_sugars.name: Jaggery Powder
hidden_sugars.risk: Dehydrated jaggery with identical glycemic impact to regular jaggery.

hidden_sugars.name: Brown Sugar
hidden_sugars.risk: White sugar sprayed with molasses for color and flavor.

hidden_sugars.name: Icing Sugar
hidden_sugars.risk: Pulverized sucrose with anti-caking agent (corn starch).

hidden_sugars.name: Castor Sugar
hidden_sugars.risk: Finely granulated table sugar.

hidden_sugars.name: Caramel
hidden_sugars.risk: Confectionery ingredient formed by heating sugar.

hidden_sugars.name: Evaporated Cane Juice
hidden_sugars.risk: FDA-reprimanded term used by brands to disguise plain cane sugar as healthy juice.

hidden_sugars.name: Fruit Sugar
hidden_sugars.risk: Industrial crystalline fructose.

hidden_sugars.name: Honey
hidden_sugars.risk: Natural nectar rich in antioxidants, but still 82% free sugars (fructose/glucose); triggers glycemic response.

hidden_sugars.name: Maple Syrup
hidden_sugars.risk: Boiled sap containing sucrose and water.

hidden_sugars.name: Coconut Sugar
hidden_sugars.risk: Contains inulin fiber which slightly lowers GI, but remains 75-80% sucrose.

hidden_sugars.name: Palm Sugar
hidden_sugars.risk: Sap of palmyra or date palm.

hidden_sugars.name: Khand
hidden_sugars.risk: Traditional Indian raw unbleached sugar.

hidden_sugars.name: Mishri
hidden_sugars.risk: Crystallized sucrose; structurally identical to standard sugar.

hidden_sugars.name: Tapioca Syrup
hidden_sugars.risk: High-glycemic starch syrup derived from cassava root.

hidden_sugars.name: Sorghum Syrup
hidden_sugars.risk: Syrup squeezed from sweet sorghum grass.

hidden_sugars.name: Isoglucose
hidden_sugars.risk: High fructose glucose syrup.

hidden_sugars.name: High Maltose Corn Syrup
hidden_sugars.risk: Corn syrup engineered with high maltose content for chewy confectionery.
